description: This file implements a custom, lock-free version of localtime() for Redis, handling timezone and daylight saving time calculations, and includes a leap year check function.

methods.name: is_leap_year
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year based on the year value.

methods.name: nolocks_localtime
methods.description: Converts a time_t value to a broken-down time (struct tm) without locks, considering timezone and daylight saving time.
